sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Publishing of Massively Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Games

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Hybrid); Panamanian corporate law under the General Law on Corporations is patterned on Delaware and Maryland common law precedents
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: United States–Panama Bilateral Investment Treaty (entered into force 1991)
United States–Panama Trade Promotion Agreement (entered into force 2012)
Canada–Panama Free Trade Agreement (entered into force 2013)
United Kingdom–Panama Bilateral Investment Treaty (entered into force 1985)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley No. 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (AML/CFT Law) as amended, together with the implementing regulations of the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF); Executive Decree No. 442 of 2017 creating the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales of the Registro Público de Panamá; related Registro Público resolutions and beneficiary-owner declaration forms; Law No. 38 of 2000 on the administrative procedure; and the Panama Tax Code territoriality rules amended by Ley 57 of 2018.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (confidential central UBO register maintained by the Registro Público de Panamá; not publicly searchable; accessible to the UAF, the Dirección General de Ingresos, prosecutors, and other competent authorities; registered agent must collect, verify, and file beneficiary data)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney (Poder General) granted by the ultimate shareholder or corporate parent to the Panamanian incorporator/registered agent authorizing subscription and execution of the incorporation deed
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the shareholder's or parent entity's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille affixed by the competent authority of the issuing country; failing Apostille membership, consular legalization at a Panamanian consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing, Incumbency, and Constitutional Documents of the corporate shareholder (Certificado de Vigencia y Personalidad Jurídica)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official companies registry or chamber of commerce of the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; alternatively consular legalization for non-Apostille jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of the beneficial owner's passport and proof of residential address plus source-of-funds statement
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent passport issuing authority and notary public in the beneficial owner's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notary certification followed by Hague Apostille or consular legalization, as requested by the Panamanian notary and AML officer

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Banker's reference letter or AML/KYC clearance letter for the UBO and the corporate entity (required in support of the resident agent's risk assessment and any future payment-rail bank account)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Regulated commercial bank maintaining the client relationship
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization accepted by the licensed Panamanian resident agent on a case-by-case basis

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of UBOs, directors, officers, authorized signatories, and app-store settlement beneficiaries against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and Panama's UAF/domestic PEP and criminal-penalty lists; PEP status (foreign or domestic), including close associates and family members, triggers enhanced due diligence under Law 23 of 2015; screening is executed at onboarding, repeated at each settlement event, and supported by ongoing transaction monitoring for the Apple App Store and Google Play payout rails.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá (registro-publico.gob.pa) — Online Name Reservation and Certification of Non-Use of Name service (Sede Electrónica and Panamá Digital single-window portal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names may be expressed in Spanish or any foreign language provided they are rendered in Latin (Roman) script; names in non-Latin alphabets must be transliterated into Latin characters; the registered name of a Sociedad Anónima must include the designation Sociedad Anónima or the abbreviation S.A.; the name must not be identical or confusingly similar to any name already registered and must not imply activities for which the company lacks the required license.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection: (i) obtain the written ground for refusal from the Registro Público; (ii) immediately refile with a modified name and request a new Certification of Non-Use of Name; (iii) if the rejection is substantive, file a written recurso de reconsideración within the statutory window, and alternatively a recurso de apelación, before the Dirección General del Registro Público under the administrative procedure of Ley No. 38 de 2000; the petition must annex the rejected certificate, the proposed amended name, and a supporting legal brief of the resident agent; the reservation is non-transferable and lapses after 30 days if incorporation is not completed.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for Stage 1: the statutory registered office may be the office address of the licensed Panamanian resident agent; no dedicated physical premises or employees are required for a foreign-owned S.A. engaged solely in global MMORPG publishing under ISIC 5820 without local banking or licensing; however, if the company later opens a Panamanian bank account or files as a Panamanian tax resident, the relevant supervised institution will require demonstrable overseas operational substance and may not accept a mere virtual office as the seat of effective management.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (approximately 12%) for an uncontaminated virtual-office S.A. with no Panamanian banking, payroll, or licenses; moderate (approximately 35%) if the S.A. maintains Panamanian bank accounts, treasury activity, or regulated licenses and is risk-rated by the UAF; the resident-agent law firm itself carries an approximately 35-45% probability of an unannounced UAF AML/CFT compliance inspection over a 24-month cycle.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability search and certification of non-use of company name (certificado de no uso de nombre) for one corporate name
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Departamento de Personas
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry tariff per the Registro Público fee schedule; disbursement payable directly to the registry

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of the public deed of incorporation (escritura pública constitutiva) including signature attestation and corporate clauses
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Panamanian notary public (Notaría del Circuito, Panama City)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing notarial market tariff as guided by Colnotaría; varies by number of folios and annexes

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration and filing of the incorporation deed with the Registro Público (inscripción de la escritura and issuance of certified excerpt)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration tariff based on stated nominal capital, subject to the minimum fee floor

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Beneficial ownership declaration and initial filing to the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales, including notary certification of the declaration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Departamento de Beneficiarios Finales
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory/tariff fee for the central UBO register plus notary certification disbursement

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed resident agent and registered office service: first-year pre-paid retainer (AML-compliant licensed attorney or fiduciary entity)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark of USD 250-450 per annum for professional resident-agency compliance services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Prepaid annual corporate franchise (functioning) tax for the first fiscal year (tarifa de funcionamiento)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos, Ministry of Economy and Finance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory flat fiscal tariff under the Panama Tax Code (territorial taxation regime)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille certification of up to three foreign corporate documents (power of attorney, certificate of good standing, and notarized passport copies)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority of the client shareholder's country of origin (e.g., a U.S. Secretary of State office)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Government fee schedule of each issuing apostille agency; excludes translation costs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Spanish translation of apostilled foreign documents, including sworn translator certification
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Panamanian certified public translator (traductor público autorizado) registered with the judiciary
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate of USD 20-45 per page as per translators' professional association benchmarks

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/KYC and sanctions screening package covering UBO, directors, PEP, OFAC, UN, EU, and adverse-media screening, plus compliance file preparation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed resident agent / AML compliance officer
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of USD 180-300 for a corporate service provider compliance onboarding package

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate kit: official corporate seal, minute book, share ledger, share certificates, and bearer-share custody undertaking forms (if applicable)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of USD 90-150 for a corporate book and seal kit

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 32 de 1927 de Sociedades Anónimas (General Law of Corporations), as amended by Ley 5 de 2019 and Ley 62 de 2021 (Beneficial Ownership Registry); Código de Comercio de la República de Panamá.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección Mercantil
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública (Public Deed) of incorporation, submitted for inscription
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum issued capital of USD 10,000 for an S.A., divided into registered shares; no minimum payment or escrow account is required at incorporation, and 100% non-resident ownership is permissible.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 001 OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [COMPANY], S.A. The undersigned members of the first Board of Directors hereby unanimously resolve: 1. SHARE SUBSCRIPTION. The share capital is fixed at USD 10,000, divided into 100 ordinary shares with par value USD 100, fully subscribed and accepted by the shareholders listed in the incorporation deed; issuance is ratified. 2. REGISTERED OFFICE. The official registered office of the corporation is established at the offices of the resident agent in Panama City, Republic of Panama; the resident agent is ratified. 3. OFFICERS. [Name] is appointed President, [Name] Secretary and [Name] Treasurer, each with full corporate powers and authority to open bank accounts and execute contracts. IT IS SO RESOLVED.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate name availability search and reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Mercantile Section, Sede Electrónica
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name search through the Public Registry online portal; obtain the Certificado de Búsqueda y Reserva de Nombre to secure exclusive use. Panamanian law rejects identical or confusingly similar names; the reservation is used in the public deed.
required_dossiers: Name search/reservation application form
Identity document of incorporating party or attorney-in-fact
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If rejected on similarity grounds, file an alternative name or submit written arguments to the Mercantile Section; an administrative appeal is available within the statutory period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and notarization of Articles of Incorporation (Escritura Pública)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública of Panama City (appointed through licensed incorporation attorney)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the constitutional deed before a Panamanian notary. At least two subscribers must sign; the deed states capital, share classes, par value, first directors, and resident agent. The notary authenticates and forwards the deed to the Public Registry.
required_dossiers: Passport or citizen ID of all subscribers and directors
Resident agent acceptance letter
Draft Articles of Incorporation in Spanish
Proof of residential or business address of subscribers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Notarial omissions are corrected through an Escritura de Aclaración (clarification deed) signed before the same notary and re-filed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with Mercantile Section of the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección Mercantil
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized deed for inscription; pay the registry fee computed on authorized capital. Upon approval, the Registry issues the Certificado de Registro, the official proof of corporate existence.
required_dossiers: Original certified copy of the public deed
Name reservation certificate
Payment receipt of registry fees and stamp taxes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a preventive annotation (preventivo) is raised, the attorney files the curing document within the stated term or requests formal revocation via recurso de reconsideración before the Public Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RUC tax registration and beneficial ownership declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) and Registro Público Beneficial Ownership Module
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the S.A. for the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) through the DGI portal and obtain the Aviso de Registro de Contribuyente. Then file the Declaration of Ultimate Beneficial Owners through the Public Registry transparency module within 30 days.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Registro of the S.A.
Notarized copy of the public deed
Taxpayer registration form of the S.A. (Form 300 equivalent)
Beneficial ownership declaration with identity documentation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: RUC data errors are corrected via the online correction form; late beneficial ownership filing is remedied through voluntary compliance payment with reduced penalty, or a formal appeal to the DGI if contested.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtaining municipal operation notice (Aviso de Operación)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Alcaldía del Distrito de Panamá — Dirección de Rentas
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Aviso de Operación for the activity 'publication of video games and digital services'. The municipality verifies the registered commercial address, land use, and office occupancy; municipal annual tax and operating rates are assessed.
required_dossiers: RUC certificate
Certificado de Registro
Lease contract or title deed of office premises
Fire safety inspection certificate (if physical office)
Identity document of the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rejection by Rentas is cured by submitting the required commercialization or occupancy document; appeal available to the Municipal Administrative Tribunal within 15 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Employer registration with social security (if local staff are hired)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Caja de Seguro Social (CSS) — Empleador Registration and SIP Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Through the CSS Sistema de Planillas (SIP) portal the corporation registers as employer, obtains the employer account number (cuenta patronal), and begins monthly payroll contribution filing. This step is mandatory only when Panama-based employees are hired.
required_dossiers: RUC number and credential
Certificado de Registro of the S.A.
Identification and power of attorney of the legal representative
Employer registration application (inscripción patronal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late employer registration is cured via SIP retroactive contribution filing; labor inspection objections are contested through an administrative hearing before MITRADEL.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) and Alcaldía Municipal de Panamá
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación (Municipal Operation Notice) for Digital Publishing Services

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) — Dirección de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category I (Low Impact) - Exempt from full EIA; pure software publishing and MMORPG services have no physical manufacturing footprint. If a physical data center or office area above permitted thresholds is operated, a Diagnóstico Ambiental per Decree 57 of 2004 would be required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No manufacturing discharge or VOC limits apply to MMORPG publishing. Office sanitary wastewater must comply with municipal sanitation standards and MiAMBIENTE effluent regulations under Law 44 of 1995. Discarded IT hardware and e-waste must be delivered to authorized recyclers under Ley 60 de 2018 on integrated waste management.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá for any physical office; municipal structural land-use approval; and occupational health and safety clearance from MITRADEL (Decreto 52 de 1992) before employing local personnel.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Republic of Panama, functionally integrated into the Autoridad Nacional de Ingresos Públicos (ANIP) from 2024; official portals: www.dgi.gob.pa and www.anip.gob.pa. Panama is a fully dollarized jurisdiction (PAB pegged at par to USD), and all tax registrations, returns and payments are denominated in Balboas/USD.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1 — incorporate the Sociedad Anónima (S.A.) at the Registro Público de Panamá and obtain the Certificado de Persona Jurídica; Step 2 — appoint a Panamanian resident agent (agente residente) as the statutory legal representative and tax domicile; Step 3 — file the Aviso de Operación with the municipal treasury of the registered address; Step 4 — apply online with ANIP/DGI for the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) using the public-registry certificate, the agent's power of attorney and the corporate questionnaire describing ISIC 5820 software and video-game publishing activity; Step 5 — obtain the RUC certificate and enroll in the mandatory electronic invoicing regime; Step 6 — open the Panamanian corporate bank account, which banks cross-validate against the RUC. A foreign-owned S.A. supplying global MMORPG services through app stores is classified as an exporter of services with ITBMS obligations at the 0% rate.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists under Panamanian law; the S.A. is per se an entity-level territorial taxpayer. Statutorily available options: (i) election of non-operating status — an S.A. whose business and revenue generation occur entirely outside Panama is treated as not economically operating in Panama and is subject only to the flat annual franchise tax (Tasa Única, currently USD 300) and the annual information declaration; (ii) simplified small-taxpayer ITBMS regime (annual gross retail turnover below PAB 200,000), which is not applicable to an app-store export model; (iii) no pass-through classification is available for an S.A., and Panama does not implement BEPS Action 2 hybrid mismatch rules for this entity type.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS — Impuesto a la Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (Panama's VAT-equivalent indirect tax on transfers of movable goods and services, including digital services)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general ITBMS registration threshold applies to corporate exporters; any person making taxable transfers or rendering services with Panamanian nexus must register before the first taxable act. A simplified small-taxpayer regime applies only to traditional retail traders with annual gross income below PAB 200,000, not to the MMORPG publisher's app-store export model. Non-resident digital platforms providing services to Panamanian users are separately required to register and remit 7% ITBMS; the Panamanian S.A. exporter remains a resident supplier qualifying for 0% export treatment.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time fiscal clearance. The Panamanian electronic invoicing regime (Facturación Electrónica), implemented under DGI Resolution No. 201-1663 of 14 April 2021 and administered by ANIP/DGI, requires every RUC holder to issue e-invoices through ANIP-certified billing software, transmit the electronic XML in real time to ANIP's fiscal clearance platform, and display the valid Código de Autenticación Digital (CAD) and QR code on each Documento Tributario Electrónico. Export invoices must be issued at the 0% rate with the corresponding export annexure code, and the monthly ITBMS return (Form 441) and annual income tax return are filed through the ANIP e-filing system. For distribution via Apple App Store and Google Play, zero-rated e-invoices are issued to non-resident customers and reconciled against platform payout statements.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating (tarifa 0%) under ITBMS, not exemption, is available for (i) goods physically exported from Panama and (ii) services exported from Panama to non-residents, provided the consideration is paid from abroad and the economic use or exploitation of the service occurs outside Panama. The MMORPG publisher qualifies by proving: (a) the Panamanian S.A. is the principal licensor or distributor of the game through the app stores; (b) all end-user consideration originates from foreign users via Apple and Google settlement entities; (c) the digital service is not consumed in Panama; and (d) the revenue is received in foreign currency into the Panamanian bank account. The 0% rate must appear line-item on ANIP-certified e-invoices and on the monthly ITBMS return; resulting ITBMS credit balances (saldos a favor) are refundable through the formal refund application submitted to ANIP after documentary verification.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: ANIP/DGI Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación) filed through the national single window for any physical export of goods, software media or master recordings
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill issued by the international carrier evidencing physical departure of the goods from Panamanian customs territory
Commercial invoice annotated with the 0% ITBMS export legend and the corresponding zero-rated e-invoice with CAD/QR code
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by the receiving Panamanian bank, or SWIFT MT103/MT202 evidence, proving foreign-currency collection from abroad

For digital services: Apple App Store and Google Play payout statements, the IP license and distribution agreements with the storefronts, monthly export-service reconciliation, and the ITBMS Form 441 filed with ANIP showing the zero-rated export lines
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: ANIP audits zero-rating claims by matching e-invoice export lines against customs declarations for goods and against cross-border settlement and bank remittance records for digital services. Where export evidence fails traceability, ANIP reclassifies the transactions to 7% ITBMS, assesses accrued late interest and levies fines from PAB 50 to PAB 5,000 under the Código Fiscal. Intentional falsification of export documents to obtain zero-rating or illicit refunds constitutes tax fraud (defraudación tributaria) under Law No. 116 of 2019, punishable by imprisonment and monetary penalties, with retrospective clawback of credited or refunded ITBMS. The statute of limitations for corrective assessments is five fiscal years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Panama has no central bank. The monetary framework is based on the free circulation of the U.S. dollar as legal tender, with the balboa as a nominal unit at parity. Banking regulation is carried out by the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP); fiscal and macro-prudential policy is coordinated by the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF). No central FX approval body exists.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full and unrestricted convertibility. The Panamanian banking system operates wholly in U.S. dollars, and there is no capital account or current account convertibility control. Dividends, profit remittances, royalty payments, service fees, and capital repatriation may be freely made without prior central bank authorization. Panama applies a territorial tax system, which further reduces compliance friction for offshore digital gaming revenue. The only documentary requirements arise from bank KYC/AML policies and tax reporting obligations (e.g., Form 960 for territorial income under relevant modalities). There is no exchange-rate spread imposed by the government and no mandatory conversion of inbound or outbound payments.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export-proceeds surrender or conversion requirement exists. Panama does not mandate the repatriation, surrender, or forced conversion of export receipts into local currency. For the MMORPG global publishing entity, proceeds from Apple App Store and Google Play payouts may be freely retained in USD or any foreign convertible currency, transferred to offshore treasury accounts, and used without time limit or conversion ratio. No export declaration is required for services or digital goods for tax purposes beyond normal invoicing and local territorial tax compliance.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account — primary treasury account for local operating expenses and tax payments
Operational Account — USD commercial clearing, payroll, and trade settlement
Capital Escrow Account and multi-currency cross-border settlement
Operational Account — merchant acquisition and treasury cards
Operational Account — commercial cash management and lending
Cross-border liquidity account — USD Nostro clearing

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Moderate feasibility with significant legal constraint. Offshore digital EMI institutions are not authorized to take deposits or operate as banks in Panama without an SBP banking or payment-services license. They may function solely as supplementary collection or disbursement rails, particularly for App Store/Google Play settlement conversion and low-value disbursements, but must not be the primary treasury concentration point. Funds held with unlicensed EMIs are not protected by Panamanian banking secrecy or deposit guarantees and may trigger heightened AML scrutiny when wired to tier-1 Panamanian bank accounts. A vetted fintech partner offering segregated client accounts and full API audit trailing can be used but must be underwritten by a top-tier bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Generally, at least one director and the resident legal representative must appear physically before the bank's compliance officer for initial account opening. Certain tier-1 banks allow remote onboarding using notarized and apostilled board resolutions, passport copies, and a video interview, but this is normally restricted to low-risk Panamanian S.A.s with the founder/beneficial owner of clean provenance. For the global gaming holding structure, it is strongly recommended that the controlling shareholder or a designated director travel to Panama or use the foreign branch of the same banking group (e.g., Scotiabank) to satisfy in-person KYC. Signature cards must be notarized and legalised; if the entity uses a Panama-registered agent, the agent may be required to co-sign or provide a certified copy of the public registry folio.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Legal-person opacity: S.A. with bearer share history or incomplete beneficial ownership disclosure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver a complete registered share deposit certificate, the registered agent's Fiú (public registry certificate), an updated beneficial ownership declaration listing direct and indirect holders, copies of the passports of all natural-person beneficial owners, and a sworn statement that no bearer shares remain outstanding. Include a notarized corporate resolution approving the opening and designating signatories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Gaming-industry exposure: perceived high chargeback risk and virtual currency transactions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide audited or management-reviewed financial statements, Apple App Store and Google Play payout reports, payment processor settlement history, customer terms of service, refund policy, and platform eligibility. Submit a written compliance analysis confirming that MMORPG virtual items are in-game consumables, not financial securities, and that the company does not operate a secondary market or exchange. Add an internal AML/CFT manual tailored to digital gaming.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk inbound wire from a jurisdiction with FATF monitoring or from a pay-out aggregator
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: For the initial capital injection, use the shareholder's own bank account in the same legal name and avoid mixing personal gifts or crypto-derived funds. Provide three months of bank statements, a notarized source-of-funds letter, the incorporation and share-registry documents of the shareholder, and a board resolution approving the contribution. For App Store/Google Play disbursements, show contractual chain and settlement reports demonstrating zero involvement of shell counterparties.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-territory ambiguity: non-filing under territorial regime raising substance queries
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Prove economic substance: physical office lease or service agreement in Panama, local general manager or registered agent with actual management functions, payroll records for local staff, and evidence of board meetings held in Panama. File initial tax registration and provisional territorial income declarations on time. Retain a Panama tax counsel opinion classifying foreign app-store receipts as non-Panamian sourced unless attributable to a fixed establishment.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: (1) use the foreign shareholder's depositary bank to issue a SWIFT MT103 U.S. dollar wire; (2) include ordering customer (Field 50K) exactly matching the shareholder legal name; (3) beneficiary bank (Field 57A) using a top-tier Panamanian bank with a USD clearing address; (4) beneficiary (Field 59) as 'PA_CORP S.A.'; (5) in field 70 (remittance information), specify 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION / SHARE SUBSCRIPTION' plus a reference to the board authorization; (6) provide the Panamanian bank with the signed board resolution, share subscription documents, and a source-of-funds letter. Panama has no government approval for FDI, but the bank may request tax ID (RUC) and 'Declaración de Operaciones con Terceros' to support the transfer. Avoid using personal or non-identical-name accounts as the originator.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails: (1) high-value supplier, platform, and royalty payments via SWIFT MT103 through the Panamanian bank's USD correspondent; (2) commercial letters of credit by SWIFT MT700/M T731 for bulk infrastructure or hosting procurement requiring documentary protection; (3) local ACH payments through the Panamanian Chamber of Commerce clearing system (Cámara de Compensación de Panamá) for domestic operating bills; (4) same-day internal bank transfers for payments within the same banking group; (5) for App Store/Google Play payouts, use platform-directed settlement directly into the company's U.S.-dollar operating account at a major U.S. correspondent, then forward a clean MT103 to the Panama treasury. All outbound wires must reference an invoice contract or a service agreement and preserve the underlying documentation in the treasury file to satisfy SBP inspection and tax-evidence requirements.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: U.S. dollar forwards (non-applicable because Panama is dollarized; no local FX forward is necessary)
Cross-currency forwards on EUR, GBP, JPY, and other convertible currencies for non-USD app-store proceeds
Currency swaps under ISDA Master Agreement for tenured non-USD treasury balances
Foreign-exchange options (vanilla options) purchased from licensed international banks for convertibility protection
Off-shore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for emerging-market receivables, subject to the bank's counterparty credit approval and SBP derivative-activity registration
Collateralized cross-currency basis swaps for multi-currency liquidity buffers

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax (Tasa Única Anual / Impuesto Anual Paid by Corporations)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 December of each calendar year for existing corporations; prepaid at incorporation for newly constituted Sociedad Anónima
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment triggers USD 50 penalty plus monthly compounding 5% surcharge up to 50%; prolonged non-payment leads to DGI enforcement, restriction of registry transactions, and administrative strike-off of the corporate registration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Shareholder Report (Informe Anual de Accionistas)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección Mercantil / Registro de Personas Jurídicas (filed through the registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 calendar days following the anniversary of incorporation or registration in the Public Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file results in fines determined by the Registro Público, temporary suspension of the issuance of certifications, ineligibility to record corporate documents, and eventual strike-off after continued non-compliance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Declaration (Declaración Anual de Beneficiario Final)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Beneficial Ownership Registry (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by the anniversary date of incorporation or within 15 calendar days after any share transfer or material UBO change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines under Law 254 of 2021 ranging from USD 500 to USD 5,000 per infraction; registration suspensions and inability to obtain good standing certificates

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración Anual de Renta)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months after fiscal year-end; for calendar year companies, due on or before 15 March of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly retroactive interest of 2% on due tax plus a penalty surcharge of 10% to 15%; persistent non-filing exposes officers to criminal tax evasion liability if material omission is proven

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Panama does not impose a blanket statutory audit on private S.A. entities. A mandatory external independent audit is triggered when (i) the taxpayer is classified as 'Gran Contribuyente' by the DGI, generally where annual gross income exceeds USD 1,000,000 or total assets exceed USD 500,000; (ii) the company is listed, publicly traded, or issues securities to the Panamanian securities market; or (iii) shareholders representing at least 10% of paid-in capital require a statutory audit at a shareholders' meeting. For a global MMORPG publishing platform with significant intra-group app-store payouts, the DGI can require audited financial statements for large-taxpayer status review.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB is implemented in Panama; private non-public entities may also present financial statements under the local Banco de Panamá-compliant GAAP (equivalent to IFRS for SMEs) as prescribed by the Colegio de Contadores Públicos de Panamá. Statutory books must be prepared in Spanish or English and be available for inspection.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Law 254 of 2021, every Panama S.A. must maintain a beneficial ownership register with its resident agent and file an annual sworn confirmation with the DGI Beneficial Ownership Registry, aligned with the anniversary of incorporation or the fiscal year reporting cycle. Any share transfer, change in direct or indirect ownership percentages, or modification of natural-person controllers must be declared within 15 calendar days. The annual UBO confirmation is a precondition for obtaining certificates of good standing and for recording any share transfer instrument at the Public Registry.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $250–$750 per year for standard Panamanian registered agent services including registered office, franchise tax coordination, and annual return preparation
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $5,000–$25,000 per year for an independent audit of a mid-size global MMORPG publishing entity; waived or reduced to a compliance review if no statutory audit threshold is met

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Panama operates a territorial tax system; income derived from foreign sources is generally exempt from corporate income tax. Domestic-source income is subject to tax at the standard 25% rate. No general statutory tax holidays exist for MMORPG publishers, but qualifying export services may benefit from reduced effective taxation under specific promotion regimes (e.g., SEM, Ciudad del Saber, or Panama Pacifico) if physically established in those zones. Standard deductions apply for domestic-source operational expenses.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 02 (Informe de Renta / Declaración Anual de Renta) filed via Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) 'TAN' (Tesorería y Administración de Ingresos) e-Tax platform or authorized bank/notary electronic channels.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing deadline is three (3) months after the fiscal year-end (i.e., by March 31 for calendar-year taxpayers). Extension is not generally available for the return filing itself, although payment may be split or subject to specific DGI installment rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross domestic-source revenue: All revenue from Panamanian-sourced commercial, industrial, or service activities, including local MMORPG sales and in-app purchases funneled through Panamanian payment intermediaries.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident entities with a Panama permanent establishment report only income effectively connected to that PE. Foreign-sourced revenue is excluded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross foreign-source revenue: Revenue derived from servers, intellectual property licensing, or sales outside Panama; exempt under territorial taxation unless repatriated through a Panama bank account in a manner deemed to create Panamanian source.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents with no PE do not file Form 02. Non-resident licensees must declare foreign-source revenue as non-taxable and attach supporting legalized documents.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of goods sold (COGS) and direct expenses attributable to domestic-source revenue, including server hosting, royalties paid to foreign licensors, and direct operational costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Allocation must be supported by transfer pricing documentation if costs relate to cross-border related-party transactions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenses and general deductions: Administrative, sales, and depreciation expenses incurred in Panama for the production of Panamanian-source income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be prorated based on revenue source. Foreign expenses cannot be deducted against foreign-source income except to offset foreign-source taxable events.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income calculation: Deductible items exhaustively enumerated under Article 58 of the Panama Tax Code; reserves, provisions, and non-ordinary expenses are disallowed unless explicitly permitted.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The PE must maintain separate books and records for Panamanian operations; head-office expense allocations require documented invoices and arm's-length justification.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable rate and tax payable: 25% of taxable income (or 15% for qualifying small taxpayers if gross revenue under threshold; if the business is licensed as a small enterprise).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident PE tax is calculated at standard corporate rate after application of any DTA or specific exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Advanced payments and credits: Includes prepaid income tax (mínimo) payments made during the fiscal year 'anticipos' and withholding tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Credits must be reconciled with Form 019 withholding certificates. Non-residents without PE receive refunds only through a fiscal representative.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Loss carryforward declaration: Net operating losses available from the preceding five tax years, subject to DGI approval and audit adjustments.
Tax paid under the 'Alternativa' regime: If applicable, minimum 4% of gross domestic revenue in lieu of the normal 25% net basis tax, if higher than regular calculated tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents with PE must apply Panamanian minimum tax rules if their normal tax is below the alternative minimum calculation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory annexes and certifications: Financial statements certified by a CPA, RUC registration certificate, transfer pricing documentation, and DTA self-certification forms.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign legal entities filing a Panama return (PE context) must submit a certificate of existence from their jurisdiction and a power-of-attorney for the fiscal representative.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty: 5% of the tax payable per month or fraction thereof, up to a maximum of 50%. Late payment surcharge: 10% interest per annum on unpaid tax. Failure to file after repeated DGI notices can result in a fixed penalty of PAB 500–PAB 10,000 and possible suspension of the RUC (tax registration). For non-resident entities, penalties attach to the Panama PE's assets and may trigger tax lien proceedings.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% (final withholding) on dividends paid, whether from domestic or foreign-source accumulated profits generated from Panama-source income. Additional 5% withholding applies on dividends paid out of profits that have not been subject to corporate tax (i.e., distribution of foreign-source profits) — total effective 10% on non-taxed profits.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Panama has limited DTAs in force (e.g., Mexico, Netherlands, United Kingdom, France, South Korea, Portugal, Singapore, UAE). To claim treaty relief, the non-resident shareholder must: (1) be the beneficial owner of the dividends; (2) obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from his or her home country DGI equivalent; (3) present the TRC to the Panamanian withholding agent before payment; (4) complete and sign DGI Form 02-23 (or official treaty-relief affidavit); (5) retain supporting documentation for 5 years. The withholding agent must file a sworn statement to DGI justifying the reduced rate. If the TRC is late, the excess withholding can be claimed as a refund within the statute of limitations period (normally 3 years).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties paid to foreign licensors for IP (including game software, graphics, music, and content licenses) are subject to a 12.5% withholding tax if the intellectual property is used in Panama. Interest paid to foreign financial institutions is subject to 5% withholding tax unless derived from public-listed bonds or arm's-length bank loans where treaty reduction may apply (Mexico 10–15%, UK 10% on royalties, etc.). Panama does not withhold tax on interest paid to non-bank non-residents for loans not secured by local assets in certain cases, but strict documentation is required.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File and Master File threshold: Transactions with related parties (including foreign parent companies, affiliates, and shareholders) exceeding PAB 250,000 (USD 250,000) annually. Full contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation is required. Taxpayers below this threshold must still comply with the arm's length principle and file TP informational return (Form 02-TP) with basic data if controlled transactions exceed PAB 75,000.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama enacted Economic Substance Requirements (ESR) via Law 254 of 2021 and Executive Decree 255 of 2022, applicable to entities licensed in Panama or benefiting from a Panama legal regime (including Sociedad Anónima with a corporate license and tax ID). Covered activities include distribution and service centers, financing, leasing, and intellectual property holding. An MMORPG publisher holding IP or receiving royalties in Panama must demonstrate: (1) core income-generating activities (development, server operations, content updates) occurring in Panama; (2) local employees with qualified staff; (3) adequate local physical premises and expenditures; (4) compliance with annual ESR notification (Form 01-ESR). Failure results in annual penalties up to USD 50,000 for false declarations and potential deregistration.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion (DGI assessment and criminal referral)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately underreporting domestic-source revenue, fabricating deductible expenses, hiding related-party transactions through shell intermediaries, or maintaining dual sets of accounting records.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil: tax due plus 50% surcharge, monthly interest at 10% annual from due date, and a fine of 100% of evaded tax if intentional (Article 709-b of the Tax Code). Criminal: 1–5 years imprisonment for tax fraud, with increased penalties for amounts exceeding USD 300,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: In cases of fraud, directors and officers who signed false returns or authorized evasion can face personal civil liability for the corporation's unpaid taxes, criminal fines, and imprisonment. Travel bans may be issued under DGI's 'preventive embargo' powers. Veil-piercing is available where the SA is used as the 'alter ego' of the director.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file TP documentation when related-party transactions exceed the threshold, applying non-arm's-length prices, or using bare-bones cost-plus margins that do not reflect the profit contribution of IP-bearing software (e.g., profit split not used even though IP is unique).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalty of up to 30% of the understated taxable income resulting from TP adjustments; immediate disallowance of deductions. Escalation includes confiscation of related benefits if abusive.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly sign TP reports without adequate economic analysis may be deemed jointly liable for penalties under DGI fraud provisions, subject to criminal liability if false documents are submitted.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance (ESR)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Panama SA holds the MMORPG publishing rights, collects large royalty revenue, but has no office, no employees in Panama, and no board meetings; all activity is conducted by the non-resident beneficial owner.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR fines up to USD 1,000,000 for significant violations (Law 254). The tax authority may recharacterize the SA as a tax-sheltered entity, impose 25% tax on foreign-source income deemed effectively managed from Panama, and revoke the corporate license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of a shell SA can be named in prosecution under the Criminal Code Article 252 (illicit association) if they knowingly facilitate tax abuse; travel restrictions can be issued during criminal investigation, and civil liability may extend to the turnover of all profits derived from the sham.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Money Laundering / AML Violation (banking and game payment rails)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting proceeds from foreign countries in breach of Panama's AML Act, facilitating unlicensed money transfer, or allowing the MMORPG's in-app payment rails to be used for cashing-out criminal proceeds without performing source-of-funds due diligence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to PAB 5,000,000 under Law 23 of 2015; license revocation; criminal asset forfeiture; imprisonment of 5–10 years for directors involved in laundering organized crime proceeds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are criminally liable for failing to establish internal AML controls within the legal entity; personal fines up to USD 1,000,000, travel bans, and extradition risk if foreign enforcement cooperates.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to File Sworn Declarations (Informative Returns)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to submit the annual sworn statement of shareholders (Form 03), the ESR notification (Form 01-ESR), or the transfer pricing declaration (Form 02-TP) when thresholds are met.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Per-form fine of PAB 500 to PAB 10,000; disbarment from government procurement; non-issuance of the Paz y Salvo (tax clearance certificate), blocking any asset sale or dividend distribution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of the SA may be prevented from leaving Panama if the entity has outstanding tax debts; DGI may issue an embargo against personal assets if the director is deemed the de facto taxpayer due to fraudulent use of nominee shareholders.
